A.explanation: Not all quantities have direction. Only vectors such as velocity need direction, while scalars such as mass do not.

B.explanation: Direction is not needed by all quantities, and a unit is needed. A value like $5 \text{ kg}$ is meaningless without the unit.

C.explanation: Every physical quantity needs a magnitude with a unit, such as $3 \text{ m}$, but only vectors also need direction.

D.explanation: Magnitude is needed by all quantities. A unit alone, without a numerical magnitude, does not specify a quantity.
